evals.prompt: I want to build something that helps people track their reading habits — books they've read, want to read, and notes on each one. I have a rough idea but nothing concrete yet.
evals.expected_output: Full set of planning documents: requirements.md with user stories and non-goals, architecture.md with ADRs, roadmap.md with semver milestones, CHANGELOG.md in Keep a Changelog format, README.md with quick start, CONTRIBUTING.md with Conventional Commits guide.

assertions.text: All 6 planning files exist (requirements.md, architecture.md, roadmap.md, CHANGELOG.md, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md)
CHANGELOG.md contains '[Unreleased]' section (Keep a Changelog format)
CHANGELOG.md contains at least one category header (Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed, Deprecated, or Security)
docs/requirements.md contains a Non-Goals section
docs/requirements.md contains user story format ('As a')
docs/requirements.md distinguishes must-have from nice-to-have requirements
docs/architecture.md contains at least one ADR (Architecture Decision Record)
docs/roadmap.md contains a v0.1.0 milestone
CONTRIBUTING.md contains Conventional Commits guidance (e.g. 'feat:' prefix)
README.md contains a Quick Start section
